region.name: Q4 Engineering Leadership Workstreams
region.summary: Working notes on fall 2026 engineering leadership priorities, covering the at-risk Investing GA and its DriveWealth reconciliation fix, Series B data room preparation for Northfield, VP Eng hiring and the comp review, SOC 2 progress, and parked Q1 2027 ideas.

brief.text:
This region holds an engineering leader's working notes for fall 2026, organized around several workstreams that run at the same time. The most urgent is the Investing GA. It received a no-go on 9/29, and three blockers remain: the DriveWealth reconciliation fix, disclosures, and Android parity. Go/no-go #2 is set for 2026-10-16, with a GA target of 2026-10-20. Board deck wording should read 'target Oct 20, decision Oct 16'. A firm decision has been made not to ship GA with a known reconciliation gap. Whether to do an iOS-only partial GA is still an open question. If GA slips, the next realistic date is early November, which runs into the Nov 14 close and board prep. Open risks include Pillar's funding cap, the Pillar remediation plan, and 20x DriveWealth load, which has not been tested (severity 4, owner Devon). The overall 'Investing GA at risk' item is open at severity 4 under Maya. A concentration risk is also flagged: four deadlines between 10/12 and 10/17 all route through Maya. The highest-severity risk is two money-movement incidents in six months (severity 18, owner Maya): the April 6 ACH pipeline failure and the Sep 26 duplicate round-up debits.

Series B data room preparation for Northfield has a real deadline of 10/12, ahead of Elena's 10/14 tech call. The eng section covers an architecture narrative, an ADR index, a money-movement diagram, September metrics (151k MAU / 101k MTU), ACH volume and cutoff records since the 8/18 cut-over, and 6-month uptime. The security and compliance section includes policies, a vendor risk register, a SOC 2 Type I summary, and incident postmortems. Three items are still outstanding there: the access review procedure, a signed SOC 2 status letter, and a decision on the remediation plan. The decision is to disclose both incidents up front. The highest-severity open item in the whole region is a todo to finish the Q3 access review (severity 28, owner Sam), which feeds both SOC 2 and the data room.

On people work, there are VP Eng interview and reference-check notes on two candidates. For Grace, the concerns are her lack of regulated money-movement experience, on-call ownership, and working with a hands-on CTO. There is also an open question about whether to disclose the Sep 26 incident to her before references. For Tomas, the concerns are process-heaviness and team velocity. The comp review plan has four parts: refresh bands with post-close data from Jordan, set the budget as a percent of eng payroll before Budget 2027 is finalized, give equity refreshes to people past 2 years, and account for a risk tied to the incoming VP Eng. A Q1 2027 parking lot, explicitly not a plan, lists the Lithic card soft launch, an outbox pipeline for the round-up sweep, retiring Rails money code, recurring investing, growth experiments, a Postgres sharding recheck, an eng blog, and formalizing the manager track. A personal reading list covers management, NACHA rules, idempotency patterns for the ADR-031 review, and Postgres MVCC. Typical questions for this region: whether GA will ship Oct 20, what blocks it, the fallback if it slips, what remains for the data room, how the incidents are being disclosed, VP Eng candidate tradeoffs, and how the comp review works.

items.title: Decision: DriveWealth as source of truth after corporate actions
items.summary: Devon's proposed fix: treat DriveWealth as source of truth for share counts after any corporate action, re-derive ours, alert on diff > 0.0001 shares.

items.title: Decision: Nadia manager-track trial conversion
items.summary: Decision on whether Nadia's manager-track trial converts is pending; wants 90 days of data, so decision around mid-Nov. Band moves to manager band if it converts.

items.title: Open Question: Disclose Sep 26 incident to Grace before or after references?
items.summary: Undecided whether to tell Grace about the Sep 26 incident before or after reference checks; leaning toward telling her before so she knows what she is walking into.

items.title: Open Question: Nadia comp review timing
items.summary: Promised 'post-close'; close target is Nov 14, so it must not slip past that.
